"He's discovered one of the secrets of power in the contemporary world, which is he's managed to turn fame into power, drama into power, and to do it in ways that leave him completely free to act. 

If you lie enough, the marginal cost of your 10,000th lie is nothing, while the marginal cost of your first, second, or third lie is very high. 

So all of the normal constraints on political figures, reputational and so on, he does not pay."

"The Donald Trump show is the most compelling entertainment, infotainment spectacle that humanity has ever seen. 

Since the dawn of time, no living human being has occupied the amount of bandwidth of the human race that Donald Trump does. And he sees that as the key to his unique power.

He is a major historic figure who has developed a new understanding of how power works in an era of mass communications and social media, and the rest of us are just trying to deal with it."

#Copper #Uranium #Silver #Gold

DAILY METALS PULSE — September 8, 2026

SEASONALITY IS KICKING IN, AND IT IS ARRIVING ON TOP OF ALREADY STRONG FUNDAMENTALS.

September begins an important seasonal handover:

• Indian festival and wedding demand starts building for gold and silver.
• China enters its traditional “Golden September, Silver October” industrial-demand period, supporting copper.
• Uranium emerges from its summer slowdown as utilities, producers and fuel buyers return to the contracting market.

Seasonality never guarantees a rally, but it becomes powerful when physical markets are already tightening.

🟠 COPPER

LME copper hit a fresh all-time high of $14,533/tonne.

Global mine production fell 1.1% in H1, while concentrate output dropped 2.6%. U.S. tariff fears are also pulling metal into America and reducing availability elsewhere.

Now the record breakout is coinciding with China’s traditional autumn restocking and manufacturing period.

Copper in the wrong warehouse is not available supply—and seasonal demand is arriving.

🟡 GOLD

Gold gained 0.6% to approximately $4,433 as the dollar weakened.

The immediate test is this week’s U.S. PPI and CPI data, with markets pricing roughly a 60% probability of another Fed hike. Yet gold continues to absorb that hawkish pressure remarkably well.

Indian festival and wedding buying should now provide an additional seasonal tailwind into Q4. High prices may constrain jewellery volumes, but investment buying and restocking can remain strong.

⚪ SILVER

Silver rose 1.2% to around $66.96, outperforming gold and reducing the gold–silver ratio to approximately 66.

Silver may have the most interesting seasonal setup of all: it can benefit from precious-metals buying in India while simultaneously gaining from the post-summer recovery in industrial activity.

When gold demand, copper strength and silver seasonality align, moves can accelerate quickly.

☢️ URANIUM

Uranium remains firm near $89.50/lb, up more than 17% year over year.

The market is now emerging from its typical summer lull. Contracting activity tends to improve from September as utilities and fuel-cycle participants return, with the World Nuclear Symposium beginning tomorrow.

Around 80 reactors are under construction globally and another 120 are planned. The long-term requirement for secure uranium supply continues to grow while uncovered utility needs accumulate.

THE TAKE:

Seasonality is not creating the bullish thesis. It is arriving on top of it.

Copper is breaking into price discovery. Gold is holding despite hawkish rate expectations. Silver is regaining leverage. Uranium is entering its post-summer contracting period just below $90.

Four metals. Four tightening markets. And now the calendar is becoming a tailwind.

You work your ass off to get a lot of money. But what is that money actually for?

Money has no intrinsic value—it only matters if you have a clear purpose behind it. Will it get you better friends, a better marriage, or a better relationship with your kids? You better answer that question first.

To me, real success isn’t about the money. Success is knowing your nature, finding the best path through that nature, and being able to look back and say, "That was the life I wanted to have."

Credit: Sam Parr, Shaan Puri, and My First Million

I have a t-shirt that says Decentralize Everything. That is 40 years of observation compressed into two words, and I finally wrote the argument down as the first guest contributor to @CryptoniteRap.

The piece is about DeSci, decentralized science.

Every institution stagnates the same way. A small group ends up controlling the agenda, that group gets invested in the current framework, and challenging the consensus becomes a career risk. I have watched it in banking, telecom, rocketry, and now science.

After 40 years I boiled it down to two rules.

1- The Draper Equation: the likelihood that a society needs to rethink an industry is proportional to the number of people benefiting from existing theories without change.

2- The Draper Corollary: the more centralized the decision-making, the less innovation occurs. The more decentralized the operations, the more innovation occurs and the faster that sector grows.

The consensus mocked Hotmail, Skype, Tesla, Bitcoin, and SpaceX too. Every time, mockery was an excellent signal.

Read the full editorial: https://t.co/kMYEnjkQTc

some thoughts on this

1/ first off must read, good compilation of projects ; really good alpha gathering here

2/ secondly from markets perspective i find that lending & borrowing is a very much solved primitive and as such new protocols dont really have much moat especially when entrenched winners move over. i mean lending, borrowing, yield - not only are these verticals solved, they're also sorely based on antifragility - w all the hacks going on, no one wants to put serious money into a protocol 2 weeks old. 

theres also no real new innovation to be done here; hence no new earnings inflection on top of existing defi revenue. 

3/ as such i dont really view lending borrowing tokens net new nor interesting

4/ dex tokens and launchpads are the obvious longs here when a chain picks up. this trade is evidently late with the top launchpad up 100x ; but i think there is space for a winning dex / aggregator - we've found the pump of RH, but the raydium / jupiter is yet to be seen. 

with uniswap on the chain though, i think an aggregator makes alot more sense than a standalone dex. 

5/ stock token pairs are very much memes - i dont think theres any new innovative layers here. at best i believe these will trade like beta to the underlying, at worst i dont see a key differential bw token1 paired to stockXYZ and token2 paired to the same stock. 

and so the framework to approach this is w akin to memes - all an attention game

6/ taking all this into consideration, to me, there is at best 5 tokens to long on RH chain - personally only like 2 ; bear in mind i am not a meme guy (bad at these games)

7/ side note - alts at these levels feels like do or die - we had the mania, we had the celebrity coins, we have all the grifters coming out of the woodwork aft 1 day. 

i will say, if we only get 1-2 weeks of pump though, that would be very disappointing, even for crypto

sometimes you just have to take a chance
